edits.after: His Q poke and minefield zone keep you off the wave with no answer yet.

edits.before: - Ziggs Satchel Charge: matchup-defining — His knockback escape — and your tower’s execution clause; he is catchable while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your R Featherstorm has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Satchel Charge (W) is 20/18/16/14/12s — his only disengage; he's catchable while it's down. - Short Fuse's charged auto telegraphs the burst, so read the wind-up, not the cast. - Satchel hits %-health, so stacked armour alone won't stop it — plan resistances differently.
